title: Support minus carrier is H^n-null under positive density (Simon 4.10(1) with the Upper Density Theorem)
statement: Let U be any subset of R^(n+l) and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure) with weight mu. Suppose every x ∈ spt V = U ∩ spt mu has a positive density: there is a real t > 0 with mu(B_r(x))/(omega_n r^n) -> t as r -> 0+ (V.HasDensity x t; closed balls, quotient in [0, infinity]). Then H^n(spt V \ M) = 0, where H^n = muHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ x ∈ V.support, ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ V.HasDensity x t) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.support \ V.carrier) = 0
